title: Detailed house
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-free background, house centered -->
  <!-- main house body -->
  <rect x="18" y="45" width="64" height="42" rx="2" fill="#6EC6FF"/>
  <!-- house body shading -->
  <rect x="18" y="45" width="64" height="42" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#9ED8FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points="10,47 50,15 90,47" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <polygon points="10,47 50,15 90,47" fill="none" stroke="#FF9E9E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- roof edge highlight -->
  <polygon points="14,45 50,18 86,45" fill="none" stroke="#FFD1D1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x="68" y="22" width="10" height="20" fill="#E85353"/>
  <rect x="68" y="22" width="10" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#FF8A8A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="66" y="20" width="14" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FF8A8A"/>
  <!-- smoke -->
  <circle cx="73" cy="14" r="3.5" fill="#C8E6FF" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="8" r="2.8" fill="#C8E6FF" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="3" r="2.2" fill="#C8E6FF" opacity="0.4"/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x="41" y="62" width="18" height="25" rx="2" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="41" y="62" width="18" height="25" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B07D56" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- door panels -->
  <rect x="44" y="66" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#A6714A"/>
  <rect x="51" y="66" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#A6714A"/>
  <!-- door knob -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="76" r="1.8" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <!-- left window -->
  <rect x="25" y="54" width="14" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#A8E6FF"/>
  <rect x="25" y="54" width="14" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#D4F4FF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="54" x2="32" y2="68" stroke="#D4F4FF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="61" x2="39" y2="61" stroke="#D4F4FF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- window glow -->
  <rect x="26" y="55" width="5" height="5" rx="0.8" fill="#E8FAFF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- right window -->
  <rect x="61" y="54" width="14" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#A8E6FF"/>
  <rect x="61" y="54" width="14" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#D4F4FF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="54" x2="68" y2="68" stroke="#D4F4FF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="61" y1="61" x2="75" y2="61" stroke="#D4F4FF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="62" y="55" width="5" height="5" rx="0.8" fill="#E8FAFF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- attic window -->
  <polygon points="50,28 58,37 42,37" fill="#A8E6FF"/>
  <polygon points="50,28 58,37 42,37" fill="none" stroke="#D4F4FF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="33" r="1.5" fill="#E8FAFF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- base/foundation -->
  <rect x="16" y="86" width="68" height="6" rx="1" fill="#7FB3D5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="86" width="68" height="6" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="#A9CCE8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- path stones -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="93" rx="6" ry="2.5" fill="#C9B99A"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="97" rx="4.5" ry="2" fill="#C9B99A"/>
  <!-- bushes -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="83" r="7" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="83" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#7BD97F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="83" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="0.5" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="83" r="7" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="83" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#7BD97F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="83" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="0.5" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
  <!-- flower dots -->
  <circle cx="17" cy="80" r="1.2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="79" r="1.2" fill="#FF69B4"/>
  <circle cx="21" cy="85" r="1.2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="77" cy="80" r="1.2" fill="#FF69B4"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="79" r="1.2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="79" cy="85" r="1.2" fill="#FFD700"/>
</svg>
